sections.text:
-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the value of the Water element weakening effect on monsters is increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 30 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: All enemies including the Rear Guard. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
Increases the Ability Power of Mage/Berserker's physical/magic Abilities by 20 when equipped in the Main Slot.
